Image inside a link produces a linked image

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<a href=\"https://example.com\"><img src=\"logo.png\" alt=\"Logo\"></a>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
